$v_{\mathrm{F}}$ & Fermi velocity of a metal, $k_{\mathrm{F}}/m_{e}$ for the free electron gas & 1 & \labelcref{sec:2.5} \\

$\vect{a}_{i}$, $\vect{b}_{i}$ & Primitive vectors of the direct and reciprocal lattices & $\text{\AA}$; $\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.1} \\

$X_{\vect{R}\kappa}$ & Equilibrium nuclear site $\vect{R} + \tau_{\kappa}$ of the static lattice & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.1} \\
$n_{\mathrm{at}}$ & Number of atoms in the primitive cell ($N_{\mathrm{at}}$ counts the atoms of a target or a calculation) & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.1} \\

$T_{\vect{R}}$ & Lattice translation operator acting on all electrons & --- & \labelcref{sec:3.1} \\
$\vect{G}_{hkl}$ & Reciprocal-lattice vector $(2\pi/a)(h, k, l)$ of a cubic lattice & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.1} \\
$\tilde{v}_{\kappa}(G)$, $\tilde{v}(G)$ & Transform of the atomic term of species $\kappa$ in a lattice-periodic sum, $f_{\vect{G}} = \Omega^{-1}\sum_{\kappa} \ee^{\ii \vect{G}\cdot \tau_{\kappa}}\tilde{v}_{\kappa}(\vect{G}) (\tilde{v}_{\kappa} = -Z_{\kappa}v_{\mathrm{C}}$ for a clamped nucleus); its one-species form & as $f_{\vect{G}}$ $\Omega$ & \labelcref{sec:3.1} \\

$U_{\vect{G}}$ & Fourier component of the periodic potential & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\
$t_{\mathrm{hop}}$ & Tight-binding hopping amplitude & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\
$v^{\mathrm{g}}_{n}(k)$ & Group velocity $\nabla_{k}\varepsilon_{n\vect{k}} (= v_{nn}(\vect{k}))$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\

$\rho_{mn}(k, q)$ & Density vertex $\langle \psi_{m,\vect{k}+\vect{q}}|\ee^{\ii q\cdot \vect{r}}|\psi_{n\vect{k}}\rangle, \rho_{nn}(\vect{k}, 0) = 1$; optical limit $q\cdot v_{mn}/(\varepsilon_{m\vect{k}} - \varepsilon_{n\vect{k}})$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\

$H_{\mathrm{e}}$ & One-electron Hamiltonian $\hat{p}^{2}/2m_{e} + U(\vect{r})$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\

$U(r)$ & Effective lattice-periodic one-electron potential & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\

$\psi^{W}_{n\vect{k}}$, $u^{W}_{n\vect{k}}$ & Bloch state and periodic part in the Wannier gauge, $\sum_{m} U_{mn}(k)\psi_{m\vect{k}}$ & as $\psi_{n\vect{k}}, u_{n\vect{k}}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\

$P(k)$, $Q(k)$ & Projector $\sum_{n}|u^{W}_{n\vect{k}}\rangle \langle u^{W}_{n\vect{k}}|$ on the $N_{W}$-dimensional Wannier manifold at $k$, and its complement & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$P$, $Q$ & Projector $\sum_{m\vect{R}}|w_{m\vect{R}}\rangle \langle w_{m\vect{R}}|$ on a group of Wannier functions and its complement & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$\phi^{\mathrm{tr}}_{n}(r)$, $A^{\mathrm{pr}}_{mn}(k)$ & Trial orbital of the projection gauge; projection matrix $\langle \psi_{m\vect{k}}|\phi^{\mathrm{tr}}_{n}\rangle$ & $\Omega^{-1/2}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$\bar{r}_{n}$, $\langle r^{2}\rangle_{n}$ & Wannier centre $\langle w_{n\vect{0}}|\vect{r}|w_{n\vect{0}}\rangle$; second moment $\langle w_{n\vect{0}}|r^{2}|w_{n\vect{0}}\rangle$ & $\text{\AA}$; $\text{\AA}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$\Delta k$, $\lambda_{\Delta\vect{k}}$ & Vector from a grid point to a neighbour in the finite-difference spread; its weight, $\sum \lambda_{\Delta\vect{k}} \Delta k_{\alpha}\Delta k_{\beta} = \delta_{\alpha\beta}$ & $\mathrm{eV}$; $\mathrm{eV}^{-2}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$M_{mn}(k, \Delta k)$ & Overlap $\langle u^{W}_{m\vect{k}}|u^{W}_{n,k}+\Delta k\rangle_{\Omega}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$\Omega_{W}^{\mathrm{I}}$, $\tilde{\Omega}_{W}$ & Gauge-invariant and gauge-dependent parts of the spread, $\Omega_{W} = \Omega_{W}^{\mathrm{I}} + \tilde{\Omega}_{W}$ & $\text{\AA}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$H^{W}(k)$, $\tilde{H}^{W}(R)$ & Wannier-gauge Bloch Hamiltonian $\sum_{R} \ee^{\ii k\cdot R}H^{W}(R) = U^{\dagger}EU$; coarse-grid (aliased) real-space Hamiltonian & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$E(k)$ & Diagonal matrix $\operatorname{diag} (\varepsilon_{n\vect{k}})$ of band energies & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$R_{\mathrm{max}}$ & Range of $H^{W}(R)$ & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$\xi_{W}$ & Decay length of a Wannier function, $|w| \sim \ee^{-|R|/\xi_{W}}$ & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$n_{k}$, $n_{1}$, $n_{2}$, $n_{3}$, $n_{k}^{\mathrm{irr}}$ & Number of points of a $k$ grid, $n_{k} = n_{1}n_{2}n_{3}$ (points along the three reciprocal primitive vectors); the inequivalent points among them & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$N_{W}$ & Number of Wannier functions & 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\
$L_{\mathrm{sc}}$, $\alpha_{\mathrm{M}}$ & Supercell side; Madelung constant of the simple-cubic lattice, 2.8373 (in \cref{app:E.10}) & $\text{\AA}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.6} \\

$\phi_{\mathrm{ext}}(t)$ & External potential coupled to $O_{b}$ in the Kubo formula & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.1} \\

$z$, $z_{\mathrm{p}}$ & Complex frequency $(\Real z, \Imag z)$ of a response or Green's function continued off the real axis; a pole of the continuation in the lower half plane & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.1} \\

$S^{\mathrm{st}}(q)$ & Static structure factor & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$\tilde{V}_{b}(q)$, $\tilde{V}_{e}$, $\tilde{V}_{n_e}$ & Potential with which the dark matter couples to the target operator $O_{b}(q)$; $\tilde{V}_{e} = \tilde{V}_{n_e} = \tilde{V}$ for the density & $\mathrm{eV}^{-2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\

$S^{0}(q, \omega)$ & Independent-particle structure factor & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$\hat{\nd}_{e}(r)$ & Position-space electron density operator $\sum_{j}\delta^{3}(\vect{r} - \vect{r}_{j})$ & $\text{\AA}^{-3}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$g_{\mathrm{pair}}(r)$ & Pair distribution function & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$\vect{R}_{\ell}$, $\vect{r}_{\ell}$ & Nuclear and electron positions of atom $\ell$ in the hydrogen-gas example & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$\omega_{\pm}(q)$ & Upper and lower edges of the particle--hole continuum of the free gas, $qv_{\mathrm{F}} + q^{2}/2m_{e}$ and $\max (0, q^{2}/2m_{e} - qv_{\mathrm{F}})$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$u$ & Cosine of the angle between $k$ (or $v$) and $q$ in angular integrals & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$N_{\mathrm{at}}$ & Number of atoms of a sample or of a (super)cell & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.2} \\
$\mathscr{M}^{1}$ & First-moment (double-commutator) matrix & $\mathrm{eV}^{4}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$j_{e}(q)$ & Paramagnetic electron current $\sum \tfrac{1}{2}\{p/m_{e}, \ee^{\ii q\cdot \vect{r}}\}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$\omega_{p}$ & Electron plasma frequency, $\omega_{p}^{2} = e^{2}\nd_{e}/m_{e}$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$f^{\mathrm{osc}}_{n0}$ & Oscillator strength of the transition $0 \to n$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$\bar{K}$ & Mean kinetic energy per electron (the relativistic $f$-sum estimate) & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$\nd_{\kappa}$, $j_{\kappa}(q)$ & Number density of the nuclei of species $\kappa$; their paramagnetic current $\sum_{I\in \kappa}\tfrac{1}{2}\{P_{I}/M_{\kappa}, \ee^{\ii q\cdot X_{I}}\}$ & $\text{\AA}^{-3}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$\mathscr{M}^{1}_{ss'}$, $\mathscr{M}^{1}_{ee}$, $\mathscr{M}^{1}_{ZZ}$ & Species elements of the first-moment matrix $\mathscr{M}^{1}$ (electrons $e$, nuclei $\kappa$); its charge-number element & $\mathrm{eV}^{4}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\

$[H, O]_{k}$ & $O$ commuted $k$ times with $H$ & --- & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$f_{2}(\omega)$ & Imaginary part of the atomic scattering factor, $(\pi/2)\omega \dd f^{\mathrm{osc}}/\dd \omega$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$\Omega_{\mathrm{arc}}$ & Radius of the large semicircle of the Kramers--Kronig contour & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.3} \\
$\tilde{R}$ & Coulomb-proper (irreducible) response & as $R$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\varepsilon(q, \omega)$, $\varepsilon_{1}$, $\varepsilon_{2}$ & Longitudinal dielectric function, its real and imaginary parts & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\varepsilon^{\mathrm{T}}(q, \omega)$ & Transverse dielectric function; $\varepsilon^{\mathrm{T}} \to \varepsilon$ as $q \to 0$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\varepsilon_{\vect{G}\vect{G}'}(q, \omega)$ & Dielectric matrix with local fields & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\varepsilon_{\mathrm{mac}}$ & Macroscopic dielectric function $1/(\varepsilon^{-1})_{\vect{0}\vect{0}}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\

$L(q, \omega)$ & Loss function $\Imag [-(\varepsilon^{-1})_{\vect{0}\vect{0}}]$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$k_{\mathrm{TF}}$ & Thomas--Fermi wavevector & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\sigma_{\mathrm{cond}}(\omega)$, $\sigma_{1}$, $\sigma_{2}$ & Optical conductivity and its real and imaginary parts; $\sigma_{1} = \omega\varepsilon_{2}$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$-dE/\dd x$ & Stopping power (energy loss per unit path) & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\phi_{\mathrm{tot}}(q, \omega)$ & Total (external + Hartree) potential energy acting on an electron & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\delta\nd_{e}(q, \omega)$, $\delta\nd_{e,\vect{G}}$ & Amplitude of the induced electron density $\delta\langle n_{e}(q)^{\dagger}\rangle /\Vol$; its component at $q + \vect{G}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{3}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$R_{\vect{G}\vect{G}'}(q, \omega)$, $\tilde{R}_{\vect{G}\vect{G}'}$ & Density-response matrix in reciprocal-lattice vectors $(O_{a} = n_{e}(q+\vect{G}), O_{b} = n_{e}(q+\vect{G}'))$; its proper part & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\bar{R}$, $\bar{R}_{\vect{0}\vect{0}}$ & Response with the $\vect{G} = 0$ Coulomb term removed; $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{mac}} = 1 - v_{\mathrm{C}}(q)\bar{R}_{\vect{0}\vect{0}}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$R_{ZZ}$, $S_{ZZ}$ & Response and structure factor of the charge-number density $n_{Z}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$R^{\alpha\beta}_{jj}$, $\tilde{R}^{\alpha\beta}_{jj}$ & Current--current response and its proper part & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\varepsilon^{\alpha\beta}(q, \omega)$, $\varepsilon^{\mathrm{s}}$ & Dielectric tensor ($\varepsilon^{\mathrm{T}}$ and $\varepsilon$ are its projections); symmetrized dielectric matrix & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\vect{J}$ & Induced current density, $\vect{J} = \sigma_{\mathrm{cond}}\vect{E}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{3}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\varepsilon_{\mathrm{TF}}(q)$ & Thomas--Fermi dielectric function $1 + k_{\mathrm{TF}}^{2}/q^{2}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\

$\omega_{\mathrm{res}}(q)$ & Resonance frequency of the single-oscillator loss function & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\
$\bar{E}$ & Mean excitation energy of the loss function, $\bar{E}^{2} = \int \omega L/\int (L/\omega)$ at $q \to 0$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.4} \\

$\varepsilon_{\mathrm{Lin}}$, $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{Mer}}$ & Lindhard and Mermin dielectric functions & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.5} \\

$\omega_{p,i}$, $\gamma_{i}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{edge},i}$, $A_{i}(q)$ & Parameters of the $i$-th term of the Mermin-oscillator fit & $\mathrm{eV}$; $\mathrm{eV}$; $\mathrm{eV}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.5} \\

$G_{\mathrm{LF}}(q)$ & Static local-field factor & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.6} \\
$\Delta_{cv\vect{k}}$ & Vertical transition energy $\varepsilon_{c\vect{k}} - \varepsilon_{v\vect{k}}$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.6} \\

$\nd_{\mathrm{gs}}(r)$ & Ground-state density at which $f_{\mathrm{xc}}$ is evaluated & $\text{\AA}^{-3}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.6} \\

$\tau$ & Imaginary time, $0 \le \tau \le \beta$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.7} \\
$\omega^{\mathrm{F}}_{j}$, $\omega^{\mathrm{B}}_{j}$ & Fermionic $(2j + 1)\pi T$ and bosonic $2j\pi T$ Matsubara frequencies & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.7} \\
$z_{\mathrm{qp}}$ & Quasiparticle residue; $z_{\mathrm{qp}}(n, \vect{k})$ that of the one-electron state $n\vect{k}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.7} \\

$\GF^{\mathrm{R}}_{dd}$, $\GF^{\mathrm{R}}_{\vect{k}d}$, $\SpecA_{dd}$, $\Sigma^{\mathrm{R}}_{d}$ & Green's functions of the level and the mixed level--band function, the spectral function and the self-energy of the level & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$; $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$; $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$; $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.7} \\

$d_{\vect{Q}}$, $\omega_{\vect{Q}}$, $\phi_{\vect{Q}}$, $g(Q)$ & Generic boson mode $\vect{Q}$, its energy, its field $d_{\vect{Q}} + d^{\dagger}_{-Q}$ and its coupling to electrons, $g(-\vect{Q}) = g(\vect{Q})^{*}$ & ---; $\mathrm{eV}$; ---; $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.8} \\

$E_{\mathrm{c}}$, $\ell_{\mathrm{b}}(x)$ & Conduction-band bottom of the model band and band-integral logarithm $\ln [(x - E_{\mathrm{c}} + \ii 0^{+})/(x - E_{\mathrm{c}} - E_{\mathrm{w}} + \ii 0^{+})]$ & $\mathrm{eV}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:4.8} \\

$E_{x}^{b}$, $a_{x}$, $\mu_{x}$ & Exciton binding energy, radius, reduced mass of the Wannier--Mott (hydrogenic) exciton & $\mathrm{eV}$; $\text{\AA}$; $m_{e}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.9} \\
$F_{\lambda}(r)$, $F_{ns}$ & Exciton envelope function in the relative coordinate, $\Vol^{-1/2}\sum_{k}A^{\lambda}_{\vect{k}}\ee^{\ii \vect{k}\cdot r}, \int |F|^{2} = 1$; hydrogenic envelope & $\text{\AA}^{-3/2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.9} \\

$\Delta E$, $F_{j0}$ & Excitation energy $E_{j} - E_{0}$ of the adiabatic states in estimates; matrix element of the force between $\Psi_{j}$ and $\Psi_{0}$ (two state labels) & $\mathrm{eV}$; $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.1} \\

$\Lambda^{\mathrm{ac},\alpha\beta}(\hat{Q})$, $\Lambda^{\mathrm{ac}}_{\nu}(\hat{Q})$ & Acoustic sound-speed matrix, $\omega^{2} = \Lambda^{\mathrm{ac}}Q^{2}$ at long wavelength, and its eigenvalues $c_{\nu}^{2}$ & $\mathrm{km}^{2}\,\mathrm{s}^{-2}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.2} \\
$D_{n}(Q)$, $T^{\alpha\beta\gamma}$, $\vect{a}_{\hat{\vect{e}}}$, $\vect{a}_{\hat{\vect{e}}}'$, $\vect{o}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{o}}$ & Order-$n$ terms $(n = 0, 1, 2)$ of $D^{\mathrm{dyn}}$ in powers of $Q$; first moment $\sum_{R}\Phi^{(2)}R^{\gamma}$ of the force constants; acoustic and optical vectors at $\varGamma$ and an optical frequency at $\varGamma$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$; $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$; 1; $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.2} \\
$a_{\mathrm{c}}$, $K$, $M_{1}$, $M_{2}$, $\omega_{Q\pm}$, $\omega_{0}+$ & Period, spring constant and masses of the diatomic chain; its two branches and the upper branch at $Q = 0$ & $\text{\AA}$; $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-2}$; $\mathrm{eV}$; $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.2} \\

$\bar{c}$ & Debye-averaged sound speed, $3/\bar{c}^{3} = \sum_{\nu}\langle c_{\nu}^{-3}\rangle$ & $\mathrm{km}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.2} \\

$\mu_{\mathrm{red}}$ & Reduced mass: of the diatomic chain, of a polar mode & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.2} \\
$\gamma^{\mathrm{G}}_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Grüneisen parameter $-\partial \ln \omega_{\vect{Q}\nu}/\partial \ln \Omega$ of mode $Q\nu$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.2} \\
$b_{\vect{Q}\nu}$, $b^{\dagger}_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Phonon operators & --- & \labelcref{sec:5.3} \\
$B_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Displacement field $b_{\vect{Q}\nu} + b^{\dagger}_{-Q\nu}$ & --- & \labelcref{sec:5.3} \\
$n_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Phonon occupation $n_{\mathrm{B}}(\omega_{\vect{Q}\nu})$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.3} \\

$H_{\mathrm{N}}$ & Harmonic nuclear Hamiltonian & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.3} \\

$\partial_{\kappa\alpha,\vect{Q}}$ & Derivative with respect to the amplitude of the displacement wave $u^{\alpha}_{\vect{R}\kappa} \propto \ee^{\ii Q\cdot R}, \sum_{R} \ee^{\ii Q\cdot R}\partial /\partial u^{\alpha}_{\vect{R}\kappa}$ & $\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\

$\hat{P}^{\mathrm{c}}$ & Projector $1 - \hat{P}^{\mathrm{occ}}$ on the empty Kohn--Sham states & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$E_{NN}$, $E_{\mathrm{el}}$, $v_{\kappa}$ & Nucleus--nucleus (Ewald) energy; electronic energy; potential of one nucleus or pseudo-ion of species $\kappa, v_{\kappa}(r)$ at the origin, its Fourier component $v_{\kappa}(G), v_{\kappa}(\vect{p})$ at the momentum given to the electrons & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$\Delta^{\mathrm{ASR}}_{\kappa}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{ASR}}$ & Acoustic-sum-rule violation $\sum_{\vect{R}\kappa'}\Phi^{(2)}_{\kappa\kappa'}(0, R)$ of computed force constants; the $\varGamma$ acoustic frequency it leaves before the repair & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-2}$; $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$D^{\mathrm{dyn},el}$ & Electronic part of the dynamical matrix & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$\psi^{(l)}$, $E^{(l)}$ & Order-$l$ coefficients of an orbital and of the energy in a perturbation of strength $\lambda$ & ---; $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\

$T_{\mathrm{d}}$, $O_{h}$ & Tetrahedral and octahedral point groups (Schoenflies labels) & --- & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$H_{\mathrm{KS}}$, $V_{\mathrm{ext}}$ & Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian; external (ionic) potential of DFPT & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$a_{\mathrm{sh}}$, $\hat{P}^{\mathrm{occ}}_{\vect{k}+\vect{Q}}$ & Sternheimer shift (larger than the valence bandwidth); projector on the occupied states at $k + Q$ & $\mathrm{eV}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\
$N_{Q}$, $Q_{c}$ & Phonon-grid points per direction; radius of the $\varGamma$-cell sphere & 1; $\mathrm{eV}$ (quoted in $\text{\AA}^{-1}$) & \labelcref{sec:5.4} \\

$\omega_{\mathrm{L}}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{T}}$ & Longitudinal and transverse optical frequencies at $\vect{Q} \to 0$ & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\
$\vect{D}$ & Electric displacement field $\mathcal{E} + \vect{P}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\
$H_{\mathcal{E}}(t)$ & Coupling $-e\sum u\cdot Z^{*}\cdot \mathcal{E}$ of the nuclei to a uniform macroscopic field & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\
$Z^{*}_{\mathrm{Ga}}$, $Z^{*}_{\mathrm{As}}$, $Z^{*}$ & Born charges of GaAs by species; their common magnitude in a two-atom cubic crystal, $Z^{*}_{\mathrm{Ga}} = -Z^{*}_{\mathrm{As}} = Z^{*}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\
$\vect{u}_{\mathrm{rel}}$ & Relative displacement $\vect{u}_{1} - \vect{u}_{2}$ of the two sublattices of a diatomic polar crystal & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\
$C^{\mathrm{an}}_{\kappa\kappa'}$, $C^{\mathrm{na}}_{\kappa\kappa'}(\hat{Q})$, $C_{0}$ & Analytic (zero-field) and nonanalytic (dipole) zone-center force constants; the single constant of the cubic diatomic crystal & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-2}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\

$\omega_{\mathrm{T}\nu}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{L}\nu}$, $\omega_{0\nu}$ & Transverse and longitudinal zone-center frequencies of polar mode $\nu$ (generalized Lyddane--Sachs--Teller relation); frequency of branch $\nu$ at $\varGamma$ without the field ($\omega_{\mathrm{T}}, \omega_{\mathrm{L}}$ for a single polar mode) & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.5} \\
$W_{\kappa}(q)$ & Debye--Waller exponent, $2W_{\kappa}(\vect{q}) = \vect{q}\cdot B_{\kappa}\cdot \vect{q}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$\mathcal{C}_{\kappa\kappa'}(R, t)$, $\mathcal{C}_{\kappa\kappa'}(t)$ & Displacement correlation function $\langle u_{\vect{R}\kappa}(t)u_{\vect{0}\kappa'}(0)\rangle$; $\mathcal{C}_{\kappa\kappa'}(t)$ where the cell is clear & $\text{\AA}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$S_{\mathrm{HR}}$ & Huang--Rhys factor & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$P_{1}(\omega)$, $P_{n}(\omega)$ & Single-phonon distribution of the self response ($\propto g_{\mathrm{ph}}(|\omega|)[n_{\mathrm{B}}(\omega) + 1]/\omega$, unit norm); its $n$-fold convolution, the $n$-phonon distribution & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\

$H_{\mathrm{g}}$, $H_{\mathrm{e}}$ & Nuclear Hamiltonians on the ground and excited electronic surfaces of a displaced oscillator & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\

$I_{p}(z)$ & Modified Bessel function of the first kind & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$E_{\mathrm{ZPL}}$ & Zero-phonon-line energy of a color center & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$\ell_{0}$ & Zero-point length $(2M\omega_{0})^{-1/2}$ of a single oscillator of mass $M$ and frequency $\omega_{0}$ & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\

$\Delta\omega^{\mathrm{anh}}_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Anharmonic frequency shift & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\gamma_{\mathrm{\Gamma},\mathrm{opt}}$, $\gamma^{\mathrm{anh}}_{\mathrm{\Gamma},\mathrm{opt}}$ & Width (FWHM) and anharmonic width of the zone-center optical phonon of silicon ($\gamma_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ at $\vect{Q} = \varGamma, \nu =$ opt) & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\

$S_{\mathrm{ent}}$ & Entropy & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\

$H_{\mathrm{ep}}$ & Electron--phonon Hamiltonian, general bare form & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.1} \\

$C_{\mathrm{F}}$, $\alpha_{\mathrm{F}}$ & Fröhlich coupling strength $(g^{\mathrm{L}} = \ii C_{\mathrm{F}} \rho_{mn}/Q, C_{\mathrm{F}}^{2} = (e^{2}\omega_{\mathrm{L}}/2\Omega)(1/\varepsilon\infty - 1/\varepsilon_{0}))$; dimensionless Fröhlich constant $\alpha(1/\varepsilon\infty - 1/\varepsilon_{0})(m^{*}/2\omega_{\mathrm{L}})^{1/2}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ (natural units); 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$\partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}v_{\mathrm{KS}}$, $v_{\mathrm{KS}}$ & Lattice-periodic part of the potential change, $\partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}V_{\mathrm{KS}} = \ee^{\ii Q\cdot \vect{r}}\partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}v_{\mathrm{KS}}$ (lower-case $v$ marks the periodic part) & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$\Delta_{\vect{Q}\nu} v_{\mathrm{KS}}$ & Mass-weighted mode potential $\sum_{\kappa\alpha}(M_{\mathrm{cell}}/M_{\kappa})^{1/2}\ee^{\alpha}_{\kappa\nu} \partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}v_{\mathrm{KS}}$; $g_{mn\nu} = \ell_{\vect{Q}\nu}\langle u_{m,\vect{k}+\vect{Q}}|\Delta_{\vect{Q}\nu} v_{\mathrm{KS}}|u_{n\vect{k}}\rangle_{\Omega}$ & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$S_{\alpha\beta}$, $E_{1}$ & Strain tensor $\tfrac{1}{2}(\partial_{\alpha}u_{\beta} + \partial_{\beta}u_{\alpha})$ of a long acoustic wave; isotropic deformation potential $\Omega\partial \varepsilon_{n}/\partial \Omega$ (Bardeen--Shockley) & 1; $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$\Xi_{d}$, $\Xi_{u}$, $\hat{k}_{\mathrm{c}}$ & Herring--Vogt dilatation and uniaxial deformation potentials of a conduction valley; unit vector along the valley axis & $\mathrm{eV}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$e^{\mathrm{pz}}_{\alpha\beta\gamma}$, $g^{\mathrm{pz}}$ & Piezoelectric tensor; piezoelectric vertex, $\propto Q^{-1/2}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ (quoted in $\mathrm{C}\,\mathrm{m}^{-2}$); $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\

$\Sigma^{\mathrm{FM}}$, $\Sigma^{\mathrm{AH}}$, $g^{\mathrm{AH}}$ & Fan--Migdal and Allen--Heine self-energies; second-order (Allen--Heine) vertex & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.3} \\

$\lambda_{\mathrm{ep}}$ & Electron--phonon coupling constant $2\int \dd \omega \alpha^{2}F(\omega)/\omega$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.4} \\
$\mathsf{D}_{\nu}(Q, \omega)$, $\mathsf{D}$ & Dressed phonon propagator $2\omega_{\vect{Q}\nu}/(\omega^{2} - \omega^{2}_{\vect{Q}\nu} - \Pi_{\nu})$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.4} \\
$\Pi^{\mathrm{b}}_{\nu}(Q, \omega)$, $\Pi^{\mathrm{b}}$ & Phonon bubble in energy units, $\Pi_{\nu} = 2\omega_{\vect{Q}\nu}\Pi^{\mathrm{b}}_{\nu}$ & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.4} \\

$\lambda_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Mode coupling $\gamma^{\mathrm{ep}}_{\vect{Q}\nu}/(2\pi\mathcal{N}_{\mathrm{F}}\Omega\omega^{2}_{\vect{Q}\nu}), \lambda_{\mathrm{ep}}$ its zone average & 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.4} \\

$\hat{e}_{\gamma}$ & Unit polarization vector of a photon & 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.5} \\

$\Psi_{\vect{k}}$ & Nambu spinor $(c_{\vect{k}\uparrow}, c^{\dagger}_{-k\downarrow})^{\mathsf{T}}$ & --- & \labelcref{sec:7.2} \\
$\eta$, $\mathsf{s}_{1}$, $\mathsf{s}_{2}$, $\mathsf{s}_{a}$, $\mathsf{s}_{3}$ & Nambu matrices: $\eta = \operatorname{diag} (1, -1)$ and the off-diagonal $\mathsf{s}_{1}, \mathsf{s}_{2}$; $\mathsf{s}_{a}$ either of them $(a = 1, 2)$; $\mathsf{s}_{3} \equiv \eta$ in the trace algebra & 1 & \labelcref{sec:7.2} \\

$\Pi_{\mathrm{T}}$, $\Pi_{\mathrm{L}}$, $\Pi_{\mathrm{T,L}}$ & Transverse and longitudinal photon self-energies, $\omega^{2}(1 - \varepsilon^{\mathrm{T}})$ and $(\omega^{2} - k^{2})(1 - \varepsilon)$ (the two polarizations of $\Pi_{\mathrm{em}}$) & $\mathrm{eV}^{2}$ & \labelcref{sec:8.4} \\

$\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{off}}_{f}$, $\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{off}}_{\nu}$ & Off-shell amplitude per unit coupling into one-phonon state $f$; on the shell of decay channel $\nu$ & $eV^{-1}\cdot [O]$ & \labelcref{sec:8.6} \\

$\varGamma_{m}$, $\varGamma^{(\nu)}_{m}$, $\varGamma^{\mathrm{tot}}_{m}$, $\hat{\varGamma}_{m}$ & Width of pair $m$, its part from decay channel $\nu$, total width $\sum_{\nu}\varGamma^{(\nu)}_{m}$, largest width within $\delta_{\mathrm{F}}$; $\hat{\varGamma}$ without index: the largest width of the zero-phonon pairs between the edge and $\delta_{\mathrm{w}}$ above it & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:8.6} \\

$\Lambda$, $P_{\Lambda}$, $P_{\Lambda'}$ & Final-state class and its projector (classes refine the sectors $\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{ad}}, \mathcal{P}_{0}, \mathcal{P}_{+}$; $\Lambda'$ a second class) & --- & \labelcref{sec:8.7} \\

$N_{\mathrm{obs},j}$, $N_{\mathrm{sig},j}$, $N_{\mathrm{bkg},j}$ & Observed, signal and background counts in bin $j$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:8.8} \\

$j_{\mathrm{L}}$, $j_{\mathrm{T}i}$, $\vect{j}_{\mathrm{T}}$ & Components of $\vect{j}_{e}(\vect{q})$ along $\hat{q}$ and along $\hat{e}_{i} \perp \hat{q} (i = 1, 2)$; the transverse current & 1 & \labelcref{sec:10.4} \\

$\mu_{\mathrm{M}}$ & Transition magnetic moment between $\chi_{2}$ and $\chi_{1}, H = -\mu_{\mathrm{M}}\vect{\sigma}\cdot \vect{B}$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:10.9} \\

$\sigma_{\ln\mathcal{R}}$ & Gaussian width of $\ln \mathcal{R}$ from independent nuisance parameters, $(\sum_{k} \ln^{2}(1 + \delta_{k}))^{1/2}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:10.10} \\

$w^{\mathrm{pol}}_{\nu}$, $\bar{\omega}_{\mathrm{pol}}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{L}\nu}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{L}1}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{L,max}}$, $\omega_{\mathrm{T,max}}$, $\gamma_{\mathrm{L}}$, $L_{\mathrm{o}}$, $L_{e}$ & Share of branch $\nu$ in $1/\varepsilon\infty - 1/\varepsilon_{0}$; weighted mean longitudinal frequency; longitudinal frequency of branch $\nu$; largest longitudinal and transverse frequencies; full width of a longitudinal line; loss functions of the ordinary and extraordinary rays ($L_{e}$ in \cref{chap:11}) & 1; $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:11.2} \\

$\mathfrak{P}^{(n)}$, $\delta^{\mathrm{coh}}_{n}$, $j_{\mathrm{BZ}}(r)$ & Momentum-resolved self density (upper end of the certified band); coherence correction $\mathfrak{W}^{(n)}/\mathfrak{W}^{(n)}_{\mathrm{inc}} - 1$; zone average of a pair phase & as $\mathrm{S}$; 1; 1 & \labelcref{sec:11.3} \\
